docs.title: 🏠 Welcome to my River Config
docs.text: A dynamic tiling Wayland compositor setup on Arch Linux. This configuration uses the filtile layout generator for a 50/50 autotiling split, features a Catppuccin-inspired color scheme, and integrates custom Waybar modules, Rofi launchers, and utility scripts.

docs.title: ✨ Highlights
docs.text:
• Layout: filtile autotiling with 50/50 split, easily adjustable via keybinds.
  • Aesthetics: Catppuccin Mocha border colors (Yellow focused, Green unfocused) against a dark base.
  • Custom Waybar: 11 persistent tags, live weather module, media player, and hardware monitors.
  • Rofi Integration: Cyber-neon themed app launcher, power menu, and music controller.

docs.text: Here are various screenshots of the River setup in action.

docs.title: 🛠️ Installation
docs.text: This configuration is designed to be deployed using GNU Stow on Arch Linux.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Ensure you have the following packages installed:

Core: - river - waybar - rofi - swaybg - swaync (Notification center) - filtile (Layout generator - available in AUR)

Scripts & Utilities: - grim & slurp (Screenshots) - playerctl (Media player bindings) - brightnessctl (Laptop backlight) - wpctl / pamixer (Volume control) - pavucontrol (Volume GUI) - swayidle (Screen idle/lock)

docs.title: Deploying the Config
docs.text:
1. Install Stow: sudo pacman -S stow

  2. Clone the repository:

    git clone https://codeberg.org/WgpArch/river.git ~/.dotfiles/river

  3. Deploy using Stow:

    cd ~/.dotfiles && stow river

  4. Ensure scripts are executable:

    chmod +x ~/.config/river/scripts/*

docs.title: 🌤️ Weather Widget Setup
docs.text:
The Waybar weather widget uses a custom Ruby script (parse_weather.rb).

  1. Install dependencies: sudo pacman -S ruby noto-fonts-emoji wget jq
  2. The script relies on /etc/get_weather for your personal API key and location. Replace with your own values before using.

docs.title: ⌨️ Keybinds
docs.text: Here are the default keybindings for this River setup. The main modifier key is Super.

docs.title: 🖥️ Programs & System
docs.text: Keybind Action Super + D Open App Launcher (Rofi cyber-neon) Super + E Open Power Menu (Rofi) Super + Q Close focused view Super + R Reload River config Super + Shift + E Exit River Super + Space Toggle floating Super + F Toggle fullscreen

docs.title: 🔍 Focus & Movement
docs.text: Keybind Action Super + J / K Focus next/previous view Super + Shift + J / K Swap next/previous view Super + Period / Comma Focus next/previous output Super + Shift + Period / Comma Send view to next/previous output Super + Shift + Return Bump view to top of stack (Zoom)

docs.title: 🗂️ Tags (Workspaces)
docs.text: Keybind Action Super + [1-9] Focus tag 1-9 Super + Shift + [1-9] Move view to tag 1-9 Super + 0 Focus all tags Super + Shift + 0 Move view to all tags Super + P Toggle scratchpad (Tag 21) Super + Shift + P Move view to scratchpad

docs.title: 📐 Layout Controls (filtile)
docs.text: Keybind Action Super + H / L Decrease/Increase main ratio Super + Shift + H / L Decrease/Increase main count Super + Arrow Keys Set main location (Top/Right/Bottom/Left) Super + M Set monocle layout Super + Shift + A Reset main ratio to 50%

docs.title: 🖱️ Mouse & Media
docs.text: Keybind Action Super + Left Click Move view Super + Right Click Resize view Super + Middle Click Toggle float Print Take screenshot Super + Print Screen record (Rofi menu) Super + C Color picker script Super + X Rofi music menu Volume Keys Volume up/down/mute (wpctl)

docs.title: 🎨 Look & Feel
docs.text: This River config uses a clean, dark aesthetic heavily inspired by the Catppuccin Mocha palette, paired with the filtile layout generator.

docs.title: General Layout
docs.text:
• Layout Generator: filtile (Autotiling)
  • Main Ratio: 0.5 (50/50 split, adjustable with Super + H/L)
  • Inner Gaps: 4px
  • Outer Gaps: 5px

docs.title: Colors
docs.text: The border colors create a beautiful, subtle contrast against the dark background: - Background: #1E1D2F (Catppuccin Base) - Focused Border: #FAE3B0 (Catppuccin Yellow) - Unfocused Border: #ABE9B3 (Catppuccin Green)

docs.title: Wallpaper
docs.text: Managed by swaybg, set to fill a custom wallpaper (Acitygirl.jpg).

docs.title: Input Devices
docs.text:
• Touchpad: Natural scrolling, tap-to-click, and disable-while-typing are all enabled.
  • Keyboard: Repeat rate set to 50, delay set to 300.
  • Cursor: Automatically hidden when typing.

docs.title: GTK Theme
docs.text: Enforced via gsettings to ensure legacy GTK apps match the dark aesthetic: - GTK Theme: Flat-Remix-GTK-Blue-Darkest-Solid - Icon Theme: Tela-circle-manjaro-dark - Cursor Theme: Layan-cursors

docs.title: 📊 Waybar & Scripts
docs.text: This setup uses a custom Waybar positioned at the top, specifically styled for River using a Catppuccin-based color scheme.

docs.title: Left
docs.text:
• Custom Launcher: Arch Linux icon. Opens Rofi (cyber-neon theme).
  • River Tags: Displays 12 persistent workspace tags.
  • System Tray: Standard app tray.

docs.title: Center
docs.text:
• Clock: Detailed date/time with calendar tooltip.
  • Custom Updates: System update checker (Pacman + Trizen). Shows refresh icon when updates available.
  • Custom Weather: Fetches weather via a custom Ruby script (parse_weather.rb).

docs.title: Right
docs.text:
• Custom Player: 🎵 Current media playback.
  • Pulseaudio: Volume control with scroll support.
  • Temperature: CPU/GPU temp with critical warnings.
  • Battery: Battery percentage and status icons.
  • Memory: RAM usage.
  • Disk: Disk usage percentage.
  • Custom Power: Power button. Opens Rofi power menu.

docs.title: Waybar Scripts
docs.text:
Located in ~/.config/waybar/river/scripts/:

Script Description check_updates.sh Monitors Pacman and Trizen for system updates. Displays icon and detailed tooltip. player.sh Media player status and control.

docs.title: River Scripts
docs.text:
Located in ~/.config/river/scripts/:

Script Description rofi_powermenu Logout, reboot, and shutdown Rofi menu. take-screenshot Screenshot utility using grim/slurp. color Color picker utility. clip Clipboard history manager (using cliphist).

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Files
docs.text:
• Config: ~/.config/waybar/river/config
  • Style: ~/.config/waybar/river/style.css
  • Colors: ~/.config/waybar/river/color.css

docs.title: 🔄 Update Checker Details
docs.text: The update checker module (check_updates.sh) runs every 30 minutes and: - Checks for Pacman updates via pacman -Qu - Checks for Trizen (AUR) updates via trizen -Qu - Displays a refresh icon () when updates are available - Displays a checkmark () when system is up to date - Shows detailed list of available updates in tooltip on hover
